seeds.why: GROSS: displace ticks[2] by +3.0 px. calibrate's own 2.5 px residual limit refuses first, so this seed is credited by the REFUSAL route, recorded distinctly -- it never reaches the LOO gate (brief s10).
seeds.reason: REFUSED before writing a metric: Equally-valued ticks on a log or linear axis are equally spaced in PIXELS. Unequal spacing means these positions are not tick marks -- most often glyph centroids of the axis labels, whose spacing tracks the label text, not the axis. That is error class 20. Re-detect the ticks from the darkness-weighted centroid of the columns OUTSIDE the axis rule.
seeds.route: refusal (calibrate's 2.5 px residual limit, reached before the LOO gate)
